report.summary: crates/font-engine: added collection_layout() (CollectionLayout/FaceLayout/TableRange) exposing bounded, validated ttcf/sfnt face and table-directory byte ranges. Rejects duplicate table tags and any within-face table overlap; accepts cross-face tables at an exact (offset,length) match as legitimate ttcf sharing and rejects any other cross-face intersection as corruption. numFonts/numTables are bounds-checked against the buffer with checked arithmetic before any Vec sized by the claim is allocated. Reuses the existing bounded readers (reader.rs), no second parser. 8 new synthetic-fixture tests in tests/ttc_layout.rs; existing 65 tests untouched and passing (73 total).
